fields.document title: The title printed on the document, such as Complaint, Motion, or Affidavit
fields.court name: The court, court unit, county, or venue shown on the document
fields.filing type: The formal title of the filing being made
fields.case category: The high-level court category or division for this case
fields.case type: The more specific type of legal case this document is part of
fields.docket number: The court's docket or case number, if one is shown
fields.case title: The full case caption or title, if one is shown
fields.plaintiff or petitioner names: All plaintiff or petitioner names, in document order, separated by semicolons
fields.defendant or respondent names: All defendant or respondent names, in document order, separated by semicolons
fields.other party names: Any other named parties and their stated roles, separated by semicolons
fields.document date: The date the document was signed, issued, or filed, including the label that identifies the date

testing_note: extractability.jsonl maps these fields to direct, semantic, optional inference, and do-not-require buckets for each PDF.
